id.description: The label used in the manuscript, e.g. fig:spread.

role.description: Matches a figure_grammar role from calibration.json.

message.description: The single sentence a reader should repeat after looking at it.

script.description: Repository-relative path of the script that produced it.

data_sources.description: The files actually plotted. A value with no source here is fabricated.

verified_in_latex.description: The manuscript compiled with this figure in place, from the brief's compile command.

verification.description: Which verification step failed, when one did.

reason.description: What is missing — a datum, a measurement, a decision — not 'skipped'.

compile_verified.description: True only if the brief's compile command succeeded after this round's figure changes.

pipeline.description: How the figure pipeline is invoked, so the next round and the artifact evaluator can re-run it.

figures.message: The tuner beats the released library on 29 of 30 operators, and by a wide margin on the sparse ones.
figures.caption: Speedup over the released library for each operator. Bars above the dashed line are faster than the vendor kernel; the annotated value is the best configuration found by the tuner.

not_rendered.reason: The round's storyline asks for a speedup-versus-K curve, but the sweep only covers K=1024 and K=4096; two points are not a curve.

example.pipeline: node figures/generate-all.js — writes every figure under figures/out as PDF.
